scenes.heading: A mistake that wastes the hour
scenes.caption: Watching every scene and then being unable to do a tiny example is the usual failure. Pause on the example for Interview concepts and actually say the result out loud. Recognition is not the same as being able to use Interview concepts and career roadmap.

items: Pause on the example.
Say the result out loud.
If you cannot, replay that scene before the next one.
